page.overview:
What is Soublades?

Ceruledge is a tall humanoid Pokémon resembling a ghostly knight. It wears dark purple armor that is segmented across its body. Its body is primarily blue with black sections at its face, feet, and thighs. It also sports greaves which are enlarged towards the top, extending outward. Ceruledge dons a dark purple segmented charcoal-based helmet, which covers most of its face, with a petal-like pattern on it. Its hands are large blades comprised of flames, which are light blue in color at the fiery ricasso/hilt but transition into a faint reddish-purple near the point. Its eyes are light purple with white flames emanating from its pupils. Two spike-like protrusions extend from the sides of its head, resembling elf-like ears, or antennas connected to a helmet. A large bluish-purple flame flows from the top and back of its head, resembling a knight's helmet plume.

Ceruledge prefer getting close to an opponent during battle and utilize their speed to strike at their opponent's blind spots. The armor that Ceruledge dons is steeped in past grudges. Being a fiercely loyal Pokémon, any hostility towards one's Trainer will result in the offender being slashed to death.

A Ceruledge wields blades of ghostly fire that transform into swords during battle. Ceruledge's blades also leave wounds that leak life energy when they have cut an opponent. As seen in the anime, a Ceruledge can also retract their blades, which will continue to emit heat.

Ceruledge evolves from Charcadet when exposed to Malicious Armor.
